text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, succinylcholine chloride is not on FDA's drug shortage list. Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC posted a discontinuation on 2026-07-23. Corvale East holds 75 vials (20.5 days on hand) and Corvale General holds 106 vials (26.1 days on hand) of the 20 mg/mL, 10 mL presentation.

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list does not include succinylcholine chloride as of 2026-10-21. A registered plant for Eugia Pharma Specialities Limited (FEI 3008461619) was classified OAI after an inspection ending 2026-02-06 and received a Warning Letter on 2024-08-15.

Our position: Current inventory covers approximately three to four weeks of use. The Fresenius Kabi discontinuation reduces one supply source. No FDA shortage listing exists at this time.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to place orders with BE Pharmaceuticals Inc. as the primary alternate source; requires Pharmacy Director approval.
2. Buyer to qualify Baxter Healthcare Corporation, Camber Pharmaceuticals Inc., Civica Inc., and Devatis Inc. as backup suppliers; requires Pharmacy Director approval for each.
3. Buyer to monitor FDA shortage list and supplier communications weekly; requires Pharmacy Director acknowledgment.
4. Buyer to report inventory levels to P&T committee at next scheduled meeting; requires P&T Chair acknowledgment.

Not recommended: No clinical protocol changes or dose adjustments; those are for treating clinicians and the committee. No panic purchasing beyond projected 30-day needs.
